name: Veefin Solutions Ltd
title: Veefin Solutions Ltd - 543931 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Veefin is a fintech software company, not a capital-cycle story; standalone revenue ~INR 70.7 cr (+90%), but supply-side evidence is thin and management is pitching pipeline and PSB Xchange ramp rather than measurable throughput.

capex.quote: suffice to say it's going to be lower than this year's number. We are nearing the end of our product IP cycle

triggers.label: FY27 capex to be lower than FY26
triggers.quote: it's going to be lower than this year's number

triggers.label: DSO 130 → 99 days
triggers.quote: our DSO is now less than 100 days. Last year, it was 130-odd days. Right now, it is 99 days.

triggers.label: Pipeline conversion 25% in 6 months
triggers.quote: at least 25% of this pipeline, we should see conversion over the next six months itself

triggers.label: PSB Xchange approved limits INR 5,400 cr vs INR 22,000 cr requested
triggers.quote: cumulative requirements of INR 22,000 crores they have requested on the platform, and approved limits at various stages are INR 5,400 crores

guidance.value: lower than FY26 (INR 187 cr); no number
guidance.quote: it's going to be lower than this year's number

guidance.value: 25% of ~$80M pipeline over next six months
guidance.quote: at least 25% of this pipeline, we should see conversion over the next six months itself

red_flags.label: Borrowings and receivables up; reclassification explanation
red_flags.quote: So, borrowings itself have not gone up, but classification of borrowing has changed from long-term to short-term

red_flags.label: Governance dispute with group company
red_flags.quote: we have taken this to the arbitration

red_flags.label: Consol revenue INR 345 cr vs standalone 70.7 cr; margins unclear
red_flags.quote: margins therefore should be read in that context because there is ongoing product investment

evasions.quote: We will not be able to share any forward-looking numbers as of now.
We haven't arrived at a definite answer on that.
I can't give you the exact number right now.
it's supposed to look at what are the approvals that you have at various stages
